summary: Frontend-only testing of 選ぶと、 (Erabu to...) visual novel. All 7 feature areas from the review request verified via Playwright: title screen, third path (Nurikabe→Farmhouse→Hearth Guest ending) with ending-tree progress, Zashiki-warashi encounter granting paper_crane gift (with no_gift gating + cross-run persistence), Kuchisake re-route with candy ending, village_return re-route with Toguchi ending, hidden truth gating (locked partial → unlocked full → relocks on missing journal entry) with 貴方は誰 revelation ending, and hard-reset clearing state. All assertions passed.

integration_issues.issue: GET /api/scene/image returns 404 for every scene throughout gameplay (console errors). Per review note this is not blocking, but the endpoint appears to be unreachable/misconfigured — verify whether backend route exists and Gemini key wired. Game continues to work because SceneCanvas gracefully handles missing image.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate /api/scene/image 404s — image generation endpoint seems missing/unreachable. Not a blocker for gameplay, but flagged as no scene art renders.
critical_code_review_comments: storyData.js is ~570 lines and could be split into per-branch modules if it grows further, but currently readable.

useGameStore.chooseOption reroute for ending_river_gratitude → village_return: kappa_pact currently uses stage 'distorted' but village_return is 'unsettling'; re-route may cause stage to visibly regress on that path. Minor narrative/UX consideration.

ChoiceButton 'once: true' flag on choice-laughter is declared in storyData but never enforced in code — gating relies solely on 'no_gift'. If gift removed, choice would reappear. Currently harmless since gift persists.

audioEngine.init is called on user gesture (start button/mute), good — but on ending-restart→start-game click sequence audioEngine.setStage may be called twice back-to-back; no functional issue observed.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage 'inga.save.v1' seeds to simulate mainRoadTaken>=1, runCount>=1 for reroute tests, and full 14-endings+9-journal state for hidden-truth gating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 review scenarios verified via Playwright with localStorage seeding. Only backend-side observation: /api/scene/image returns 404 for all scene ids — game gracefully handles this and it was explicitly flagged as non-blocking in the review request. No page errors, no blank renders, no JS runtime errors observed. Use skip-narration ([data-testid]) BEFORE querying for choice buttons since choices only render after narration completes.
